summary: BUG: Part category not available for assignment to a different matrix
reported_issue: After deselecting a part category (e.g. 'Filters') from one pricing matrix (74% Markup), the category was not available for selection when trying to assign it to a different matrix (Loyal Customer). Prevented correct pricing of that category.
expected_after_fix: A category that is not currently assigned to a matrix (deselected from its previous matrix) is available for selection in another matrix's Category dropdown.
steps_i_followed: Logged in as admin, opened Administration -> Pricing (Pricing Matrices, 23 matrices).

Inspected data model via GET /api/pricing-rules/list and GET /api/parts-catalogue/categories-list: each category carries a single pricingMatrixId; 18 categories currently have pricingMatrixId=null (unassigned, i.e. deselected from any matrix).
Opened Edit Price Matrix on 'Ahtasham Price Matrix' (which has no categories) and opened the Category dropdown to see which categories are offered for assignment.
actual_now: The Category dropdown lists exactly the 18 currently-unassigned categories and offers them for selection: .Brake Parts, .Suspension, Ahtasham, Ahtasham exempt, AUTO-Batteries, AUTO-Body, AUTO-Engine, AUTO-HVAC, AUTO-MISC CHARGES, AUTO-Tires & Wheels, C22327 PS Category, C22329 PS Category, C2618 Regression Category, C26597 Category, HD-CORE / FEE, HD-Shop Supply, Machine Sales, Suspension. A category not assigned to any matrix is fully selectable for assignment to another matrix, so a category deselected from one matrix can be reassigned to another.
notes: The dropdown deliberately shows only categories not already bound to a matrix (each category maps to at most one matrix). Since deselecting a category sets its matrix to null, it then appears in the picker of every other matrix. Verified the offered set equals the null-matrix set exactly (18/18).
